definitions.gloss: appearance; visual appeal; how something looks
definitions.explanation: The visual impression something makes; how attractive or impressive something appears when viewed.

examples.japanese: {見栄|みば}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: To make a visually appealing dish.

examples.japanese: {見栄|みば}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{売|う}れ→売れる：02012_ureru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Things that look better sell more easily.

examples.japanese: {見栄|みば}え⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}→重視：03341_juushi⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to prioritize taste over appearance.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {見栄|みば}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to look good, to be eye-catching
- {見栄|みば}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ / ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: looks good / looks poor
- {見栄|みば}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make something look better

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見|み}た{目|め}→見た目：14110_mitame⟧: looks, appearance; the everyday word.
- ⟦{体裁|ていさい}→体裁：09154_teisai⟧: appearances as others judge them, decorum.
{見栄|みば}え is how attractive something looks when presented: food, displays, photos, slides.

WATCH OUT:
- The same kanji ⟦{見栄|みえ}→見栄：06626_mie⟧ without え, read みえ, means vanity or show: ⟦{見栄|みえ}を{張|は}る→見栄を張る：15322_miewoharu⟧ (to show off). Also written {見映|みば}え.
